question: In its 279th report released in April 2023, the Law Commission of India has recommended the provision of which law to be retained?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sedition Law**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Law Commission of India, in its 279th report released in April 2023, has recommended the retention of the **Sedition Law** under Section 124A of the Indian Penal Code.
 
• The Sedition Law is aimed at penalizing actions that incite hatred, contempt, or disaffection towards the government established by law.
 
• This recommendation comes amid ongoing debates and legal challenges questioning the relevance and misuse of the Sedition Law in contemporary times.
